## Problem

Describe the reusable RTL, localization, accessibility, Unicode, packaging, security, or general UI problem.

## Standards / evidence

Link the relevant standard, browser behavior, issue, or reproducible evidence where applicable.

## Solution

Describe the approach, API impact, and trade-offs.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run scope:check` passes
- [ ] `npm run supply-chain:check` passes when workflows changed
- [ ] Unit tests added or updated
- [ ] RTL and LTR counterexamples checked where applicable
- [ ] Accessibility impact checked; no unsupported conformance claims added
- [ ] Localization/script-boundary impact checked
- [ ] Security/supply-chain impact checked
- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Browser tests updated when DOM/layout behavior changed
- [ ] No Rawafid scientific/editorial/private content, user data, production config, or secrets included
- [ ] Third-party provenance and license are clear

## Breaking changes

Describe migration steps, or write `None`.
